model.name: english_tinystories_c256_l6
model.description: Open English on TinyStories only. C=256 L=6 H=8 T=256, GPT-2 residual scale 1/sqrt(2L). Fresh TinyStories BPE. Do not --resume a cabinet BPE. 2 GB cap hardcoded.

metadata.description: From-scratch on data/tinystories/ after tools/prepare_tinystories.py. No dataset.path. Do not combine data/*.txt. Do not --resume v7/v8/v9 or English-Phase1. Product chat stays chat_facts_v7. 4096 tokens/step; 50k steps is ~200M tokens.
